sources.snippet: Overview Dolphin-Mistral-24B-Venice-Edition is a general-purpose text generation model built on Mistral 24B that prioritizes user control and minimal safety restrictions. Created by dphn in collaboration with Venice.ai, this model serves as the default uncensored option ("Venice Uncensored") for all Venice users.
